name: request_sensitive_action
description: Ask a technician to approve an account change. The caller must be verified by one-time code first. Returns an approval_id to pass to check_approval_status.

action.description: mfa_reset: move sign-in approvals to a new phone. account_unlock: unlock a locked-out account. access_grant: access to an application or group.

reason.description: Why the caller needs it, in their words.

resource.description: For access_grant: the application or group needed.

caller_confirmed.description: True only after the caller agreed to the request.
